capability.summary: Compute a matrix determinant, inverse, or real eigenvalue parts
capability.description: Parses a JSON matrix into a NumPy array and computes determinant for operation det, inverse for inv, or eigenvalues for every other operation string; eigenvalue output keeps only real components.
capability.problem_space: Three narrowly selected square-matrix calculations serialized through JSON.

constraint.io_signature: Inputs: JSON-encoded matrix and operation string; output: JSON echoing operation with a nested result containing det, inv, or eigvals.
accepted_inputs: a JSON rectangular numeric matrix suitable for the selected NumPy linear algebra routine
operation det, operation inv, or another string that selects eigenvalue calculation
constraint.output_shape: Success is an object with status="success", tool="lib.numpy_linalg", operation as the echoed selector string, and result as an object containing exactly one branch: det as a float, inv as nested numeric lists, or eigvals as a list of real components. A caught JSON, array-construction, dimension, singular-matrix, or linear-algebra exception produces an object with status="error", tool="lib.numpy_linalg", and message as the exception string, then exits with code 1.
limitations: supports only determinant, inverse, and eigenvalue calculation; any operation other than exact det or inv silently selects eigenvalues
the eigenvalue branch discards all imaginary components by returning only np.linalg.eigvals(...).real
determinant, inverse, and eigenvalue operations require dimensions accepted by NumPy, generally a square two-dimensional matrix
singular inverses, malformed JSON, ragged or nonnumeric arrays, and NumPy errors use the wrapper's error envelope
the wrapper defaults a missing operation to det even though the manifest declares it required

output_contract.description: Selected matrix operation plus a determinant scalar, inverse matrix, or real parts of eigenvalues.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: calculate a matrix determinant or inverse
calculate real parts of matrix eigenvalues
negative_intents: solve a linear system with a right-hand side
run arbitrary NumPy linear algebra operations
